body.prompt: Use the supplied full-screen Failure image only as a visual style/design reference. Create one new independent game resource, never a screenshot crop or screen reconstruction. Match the reference precisely in subdued antique gold, near-black navy lacquer, thin carved details and warm subdued light. Create ONLY the ornate blank horizontal defeat-title plaque in the reference, including its central sapphire crest above the plaque. Broad low midnight-navy plaque with softly chamfered corners, sculpted antique-gold thin border and broad airy curling gold scrollwork along the top edge. Centered large faceted sapphire in an elegant gold setting rises above the top edge. The plaque body has two generous blank text lines. Match the reference exact silhouette and restrained metal color: top crest and curly flourishes integrated into panel, not a giant diamond at every corner. Overall including crest width:height about3.2:1. No text or letters. True transparent alpha outside the complete object; preserve fully opaque interior surfaces. No checkerboard, no background scenery, no letters, no numbers, no text, no watermark, no extra items. Leave a small clear margin so all ornament tips are visible.
